name: MonarchAiCodeBlock
title: AiCodeBlock
wrapsNative: MonarchCodeBlock (ScrollView(.horizontal) of monospaced Text, Toggle for wrap, MonarchCopyButton) with a MonarchFlowLayout row of MonarchButton for Insert and Apply
summary: Code written by an assistant: MonarchCodeBlock with copy, wrap, diffs and line numbers, plus optional Apply and Insert actions that hand the code back to the app.
whenToUse: In an assistant's answer, for code the person may copy, apply to a file or insert into an editor, including a diff that is still streaming.
whenNotToUse: For code samples in documentation or settings, with nothing to apply, use MonarchCodeBlock. For a side-by-side or full-file comparison, use a diff viewer.
api: init(_ code: String, language: String? = nil, title: String? = nil, isDiff: Bool? = nil, isHighlighted: Bool = true, showsLineNumbers: Bool = false, showsWrapToggle: Bool = true, isCopyable: Bool = true, isIncomplete: Bool = false, isWrapped: Binding<Bool>? = nil, labels: MonarchAiCodeBlockLabels = MonarchAiCodeBlockLabels(), onCopy: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onInsert: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onApply: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ code: String, language: String? = nil, title: String? = nil, isDiff: Bool? = nil, isHighlighted: Bool = true, showsLineNumbers: Bool = false, showsWrapToggle: Bool = true, isCopyable: Bool = true, isIncomplete: Bool = false, isWrapped: Binding<Bool>? = nil, labels: MonarchAiCodeBlockLabels = MonarchAiCodeBlockLabels(), onCopy: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onInsert: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onApply: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil) where Actions == EmptyView

struct MonarchAiCodeBlockLabels { init(apply: String? = nil, insert: String? = nil, actionLabel: (@Sendable (String, String) -> String)? = nil, incompleteHint: String? = nil, codeBlock: MonarchCodeBlockLabels = MonarchCodeBlockLabels()) }

options.name: code
options.description: The code, exactly as it should be copied, applied and inserted.

options.name: language
options.description: A language id that picks the highlighter and the header text; "diff" or "patch" turns on the diff mode.

options.name: title
options.description: The header text, such as a file name (the web's filename). It also names the code for VoiceOver and the action buttons.

options.name: isDiff
options.description: Forces the diff mode on or off.

options.name: showsLineNumbers
options.description: Line numbers before the lines, not read by VoiceOver.

options.name: showsWrapToggle
options.description: The wrap toggle in the header.

options.name: isCopyable
options.description: The copy button in the header.

options.name: isIncomplete
options.description: The code is still arriving: Apply and Insert are disabled, with a hint saying why. Copy stays available.

options.name: isWrapped
options.description: Controls wrapping; without it the block keeps the state itself, starting unwrapped.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Apply, Insert, the spoken action names, the incomplete hint and the code block's own strings.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Runs with the copied code after each copy.

options.name: onInsert
options.description: Adds a secondary Insert button that hands over the code.

options.name: onApply
options.description: Adds a primary Apply button that hands over the code.

options.name: actions
options.description: App controls placed in the action row before Insert and Apply.

states.name: ready
states.description: The code block, then a trailing row with the app's controls, Insert (secondary) and Apply (primary).

states.name: incomplete
states.description: Insert and Apply are disabled while the code streams in; Copy works on what has arrived.

states.name: diff
states.description: Added and removed lines with markers and the AI diff colours of MonarchCodeBlock.

states.name: no actions
states.description: Without onApply, onInsert or actions there is no action row: the block is a plain MonarchCodeBlock.

appearance: The code block's muted surface, border and header, then Monarch buttons in the secondary and primary variants. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: On the web Apply and Insert sit in the block's header. MonarchCodeBlock has no slot for extra header controls, so on iOS they are in a row under the code; a header slot on MonarchCodeBlock would let them move up. The web re-tokenises streaming code incrementally; iOS re-tokenises the whole code on each update. The web names the header text filename; iOS calls it title, as MonarchCodeBlock does. Android has the same parameters.
accessibility: The code is read as MonarchCodeBlock reads it: a container named after the title or language, one element per line, added and removed lines named.
Apply and Insert are buttons named with the code, such as "Apply server.ts".
While the code is incomplete they are disabled and their hint is "Available when the code is complete".
Every button has a 44-point touch target; the row wraps at large text sizes.
edgeCases: Empty code still shows the header and one empty line.
Apply and Insert receive the code as given, including a trailing newline.
With several blocks in one answer, give each a title so the actions are told apart.
